description.text: A Brief Introduction toBiological Engineering Biological Engineering is the use of living systems and organisms to develop or make products, or "any technological application that uses biological systems, living organisms or derivatives thereof, to make or modify products or processes for specific use".Depending on the tools and applications, it often overlaps with the (related) fields of Biopharmaceuticals track, bioengineering, biomedical engineering, biomanufacturing, etc.Biotechnology has expanded to include new and diverse sciences such as genomics, recombinant gene techniques, applied immunology, and development of pharmaceutical therapies and diagnostic tests.. Clickhereto find out more information aboutCollege of Life Sciences. Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Bachelor Degree ofBiological Engineeringby Liaocheng University Future Career Biological has a wide variety of career opportunities ranging from sales and marketing, to research and development, to manufacturing and quality control and assurance.The biotechnology industry continues to flourish nationwide. Not only are the total number of biotechnology companies increasing, but employment in the biotechnology field continues to grow as well. duration.text: The Biological Engineering at Liaocheng University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3444 USD/per year ￥ 24800 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Certificate of English proficiency test IELTS or TOEFl will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker. 7. Financial guarantee letter Photocopy of the signatured financial guarantee letter from his/her financial guarantor to prove their solvency. 8. Certificate of No-Criminal Record

requirements.text: 1. Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 2. High school graduate or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate 3. Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
